The number 1 gamer within the academy who is almost considered as the idol of the gaming world. She is equally popular with both girls and boys due to her outgoing and honest personality. She is also a childhood friend and neighbor of Koharu.

segments.text: Affiliation: Luminous Academy, class 2-C
Class: Sacred Princess
Hobbies: Watching hero shows, cooking (good at French cuisine, but bad at Japanese)

The daughter of a leading and very famous game-making french company who is also a game designer and a very good programmer herself. She and Maher consider each other their rival. At first glance, one might suspect Reina to be a refined, traditional rich girl; however, in reality, she has bad misconceptions about Japan because she learned everything through anime and games.
Affiliation: Luminous Academy Middle School Section, class 3-B
Class: Lovely Princess
Wish: To get married with her Onii-chan
Hobbies: Collecting cute stuff

Koharu's spoiled and energetic younger sister who is head over heels for him. She is openly aggressive towards her brother, and never forgets the chance to mention that she wants to get married with him. Hiyoko doesn't like games that much, but has a knack for all kinds of lottery games found in the shopping district.
Affiliation: Luminous Academy, class 3-A
Class: Glory Princess
Hobbies: Playing retro games, reading, writing ranobes

Luminous Academy's student council president who has a kind but firm personality. She has a bad habit of creating misundertandings and panicking over them, and often having erotic delusions (though one can't be aware of this as she keeps her serious face on in the real world whenever she is having delusions). Her home is a book store that sells used books, where she helps out often. Eve's dream is to become a scenario writer for games, or at least be connected to the gaming industry.
Affiliation: Felicia All-Girls' School, class 1-A
Class: Martial Art Princess
Hobbies: Saving money, walking through the Chinatown
Favorite food: Anything that sounds cute and is sweet
Disliked food: Sweets that are made from using animals (because she feels bad for them)

The only daughter of the Chinatown's mafia boss' who is Chinese herself. Due to her status as the mafia boss' daughter, she has been equipped with a wide variety of weapons, which she hides, for example, inside her skirt. But despite her status, Anko is a kind and refined girl loved by the people of the Chinatown; she loves them the same amount. For unknown reasons, Anko wants to save a lot of money, which she always puts into her frog purse as her savings.
Hobbies: Collecting stealthily information for her master, playing alone
Anko's maid. She is an otaku who picked her talking patterns from her favorite anime.
The host of the whole battle event.

The mysterious girl who led Koharu into the world of CrownHearts. Despite being the navigator character for the game, she stays in the real world with Koharu and the others. Strongly believes to have lost her memories at least partially and that they have scattered around just like pieces of trash. However, everything she sees in the real world is fresh and new to her, especially the food: Polina is shown to have a tremendous appetite.
Affiliation: Luminous Academy Middle School Section, class 3-B
Class: Diva Princess
Hobbies: Sharing videos, DTM

Hiyoko's best friend and classmate, the two have known each other ever since elementary school. Naturally airheaded and carefree, Ayane gets along with almost anybody, regardless of their age or gender. She is quite popular on the internet due to her own show as a net idol. She started her career as a net idol due to her brother's influence, who is an idol otaku.
Affiliation: The master of Café Poussan
Hobbies: Petit traveling (has no longer time for it), secretly buying BL books
Hobbies: Cooking, searching info about sweets

The protagonist. He is a very kind person who can't leave a person in need of help alone, and is particularly kind to girls, especially to his younger sister Hiyoko. Due to his mother's guidance - who is a professional gamer - he has mastered the skill of being able to play any kind of game there is. Because Polina found his intellectual playstyle and skills interesting, she decided to make him participate in Divine Crown Battle VR as the "king".
